"""Pick up an articulated YCB tool and drive its parts' joints to goals while
holding it.

Each tool's task (:data:`TASKS`) is the pickup the pinch lift already judges,
then :class:`~scripts.screwdriver_grasp_mpc.Actuate` stages: press the drill's
trigger past its switch, close the adjustable wrench's jaw by one worm turn
and open it again, open the scissors and close them, and squeeze the Windex
bottle's trigger through a third of its stroke while holding it upright. The
spring clamps only lift. Every stage holds for the runner's hold time, and a
stage's hold counts only while its part's joint meets the stage's goal.

The objective, :class:`ActuatedGrasp`, reads the parts' joints from the
fixture's ``parts.json`` (:mod:`scripts.articulate_fixture`) and reports each
joint with the quantities the tools' own formulas derive from them
(:data:`DERIVED`). Run on a fixture the study's build readied
(``python -m scripts.stock_fixture``)::

    python -m scripts.actuate_mpc --input <fixture> --output <run> --duration 90
"""

#: Cost of a part joint's whole travel left to its goal: a turn's half turn
#: left (:data:`~scripts.screwdriver_grasp_mpc.ORIENT_WEIGHT`), so pressing
#: trades against the grip's terms as turning does.
ACTUATE_WEIGHT = ORIENT_WEIGHT
#: Least cosine between a tool's base-to-tip port axis and its scan's up for
#: the tool to stand as scanned, :data:`UPRIGHT`'s tolerance: such a tool is
#: pinched about and gripped along the scan's up, as the upright pinch lift
#: reads a standing bottle.
STANDING_COSINE = math.cos(float(UPRIGHT.tolerance.to("rad").value))


def _metres(value: float) -> unxt.AbstractQuantity:
    return unxt.Quantity(jnp.asarray(value), "m")


def _radians(value: float) -> unxt.AbstractQuantity:
    return unxt.Quantity(jnp.asarray(value), "rad")


with jax.enable_x64():
    #: The drill's trigger travel, from rest to its stop.
    TRIGGER_TRAVEL = (_metres(0.0), _metres(DRILL_TRIGGER.travel))
    #: The wrench's jaw travel, reading zero at the scanned opening.
    JAW_TRAVEL = (
        _metres(-WRENCH_SCANNED_OPENING),
        _metres(WRENCH_MAX_OPENING - WRENCH_SCANNED_OPENING),
    )
    #: The scissors' right loop's turn, from closed to the halves' stop.
    LOOP_TRAVEL = (_radians(0.0), _radians(SCISSORS.stop))
    #: The sprayer trigger's swing, from its rest stop to its squeezed stop.
    SPRAY_TRAVEL = (_radians(0.0), _radians(WINDEX_TRIGGER.swing))
    #: Each tool's task, by YCB name: the pickup's lift, then its actuations.
    TASKS: Mapping[str, Task] = {
        # Press the trigger through the switch's closing travel; the button
        # starts at a side (scripts.articulate_fixture.STARTS), whose blocker
        # otherwise stops the trigger at rest.
        "035_power_drill": (
            PINCH_LIFT[0],
            Actuate(
                part="trigger",
                goal=JointGoal(
                    bound="at_least",
                    value=_metres(DRILL_TRIGGER.switch_point),
                    range=TRIGGER_TRAVEL,
                ),
                charge=ACTUATE_WEIGHT,
            ),
        ),
        # Close the jaw by one worm turn from the scanned opening, then open
        # it back to the scanned opening.
        "042_adjustable_wrench": (
            PINCH_LIFT[0],
            Actuate(
                part="jaw",
                goal=JointGoal(
                    bound="at_most",
                    value=_metres(-WRENCH_WORM.pitch),
                    range=JAW_TRAVEL,
                ),
                charge=ACTUATE_WEIGHT,
            ),
            Actuate(
                part="jaw",
                goal=JointGoal(bound="at_least", value=_metres(0.0), range=JAW_TRAVEL),
                charge=ACTUATE_WEIGHT,
            ),
        ),
        # Open to the opening of surgical scissors in use, about 30 degrees
        # (Greenish et al. 2002, as SCISSORS cites), then close.
        "037_scissors": (
            PINCH_LIFT[0],
            Actuate(
                part="right_loop",
                goal=JointGoal(bound="at_least", value=deg(30.0), range=LOOP_TRAVEL),
                charge=ACTUATE_WEIGHT,
            ),
            Actuate(
                part="right_loop",
                goal=JointGoal(bound="at_most", value=deg(5.0), range=LOOP_TRAVEL),
                charge=ACTUATE_WEIGHT,
            ),
        ),
        # Lift upright and squeeze through a third of the full stroke, past
        # which a stroke sprays (WINDEX_TRIGGER.third_output), still upright.
        "022_windex_bottle": (
            UPRIGHT_LIFT[0],
            Actuate(
                part="trigger",
                goal=JointGoal(
                    bound="at_least",
                    value=_radians(gauge_angle(WINDEX_TRIGGER.full_stroke / 3)),
                    range=SPRAY_TRAVEL,
                ),
                charge=ACTUATE_WEIGHT,
                pointing=UPRIGHT,
            ),
        ),
        "050_medium_clamp": PINCH_LIFT,
        "051_large_clamp": PINCH_LIFT,
        "052_extra_large_clamp": PINCH_LIFT,
    }
    #: Each tool's grips a run proposes without ``--grips``, by YCB name, as

    STOCK_GRIPS: Mapping[str, tuple[Grip, ...]] = {
        # The finger row centred 21 mm up the trigger's 27 mm face, so two

        "035_power_drill": (Grip(site=mm(-5.0)),),
        "042_adjustable_wrench": (CENTRE_GRIP,),
        "037_scissors": (CENTRE_GRIP,),
        # The trigger's lever below its hinge, 225 mm up the scan, 118 mm

        "022_windex_bottle": (Grip(site=mm(118.0)),),
        "050_medium_clamp": (CENTRE_GRIP,),

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Derived:
    """A quantity a tool's own formula derives from its part joints
    (:mod:`robotl.examples.ycb_artifacts`).

    :param name: The key it is measured under.
    :param reads: The jointed parts it reads, each by label and joint kind,
        in the order :attr:`formula` takes their positions; a tool reports
        it when it has them all.
    :param formula: The quantity of those joints' positions, in their units.
    """

    name: str
    reads: tuple[tuple[str, mujoco.mjtJoint], ...]
    formula: Callable[..., float | bool]


SLIDE, HINGE = mujoco.mjtJoint.mjJNT_SLIDE, mujoco.mjtJoint.mjJNT_HINGE
#: How far a part joint may read past a stop, by joint kind, before the tool
#: counts as broken: a part pressed into a stop sinks into its soft limit by
#: a fraction of this, while one driven through it in a step can jam past
#: it, as the drill's trigger jams in its button.
BEYOND_STOP: Mapping[mujoco.mjtJoint, float] = {
    SLIDE: 0.001,
    HINGE: float(np.radians(2.0)),
}
#: The quantities the tasks are scored by, in the units the tools are
#: specified in, which a tool reports when it has the parts they read: the
#: drill presses as far as it can, scored by its largest travel held through
#: a stage, the wrench by its jaw's smallest and largest opening, the
#: scissors by their largest and final opening and the bottle by its largest
#: stroke while upright. A stage's goal is the joint position the same
#: formula puts at the task's threshold. Each reads its parts' positions
#: clipped to their travel, so a part past its stop reads as at the stop.
DERIVED = (
    Derived("trigger_travel_m", (("trigger", SLIDE),), float),
    # The switch closes past its point only with the button at a side; the
    # centred button's blocker locks the trigger at rest.
    Derived(
        "switch_closed",
        (("trigger", SLIDE), ("button", SLIDE)),
        lambda travel, button: bool(
            travel >= DRILL_TRIGGER.switch_point
            and abs(button) > DRILL_BUTTON.travel / 2
        ),
    ),
    # The jaw reads zero at the scanned opening.
    Derived(
        "jaw_opening_m", (("jaw", SLIDE),), lambda jaw: WRENCH_SCANNED_OPENING + jaw
    ),
    # The right loop reads zero closed, so its angle is the blades' opening.
    Derived("scissors_opening_rad", (("right_loop", HINGE),), float),
    Derived("spray_stroke_m", (("trigger", HINGE),), gauge_stroke),
)


def read_parts(fixture: Path, model: mujoco.MjModel) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Each jointed part of the fixture's tool by its label, with its joint's
    position address in ``model``'s ``qpos``.

    :param fixture: A fixture :func:`~scripts.articulate_fixture.articulate`
        readied, holding ``parts.json``.
    :param model: The fixture's compiled scene.
    :raises KeyError: When ``model`` lacks a recorded joint or body.
    :raises ValueError: When a recorded joint moves another body.
    """
    record = PartsRecord.read(fixture)
    addresses = {}
    for label, part in record.parts.items():
        if part.joint is None:
            continue
        joint = model.joint(part.joint)
        if int(joint.bodyid[0]) != model.body(part.body).id:
            raise ValueError(f"{part.joint} does not move {part.body}")
        addresses[label] = int(joint.qposadr[0])
    return addresses


def joint_at(model: mujoco.MjModel, address: int) -> int:
    """The slide or hinge joint whose position is ``qpos[address]``.

    :raises ValueError: When none is.
    """
    (joint,) = np.flatnonzero(
        (model.jnt_qposadr == address) & np.isin(model.jnt_type, [SLIDE, HINGE])
    )
    return int(joint)


def check_stage(model: mujoco.MjModel, parts: Mapping[str, int], stage: Stage) -> None:
    """Refuse an :class:`Actuate` stage that ``model``'s tool cannot run.

    :param parts: The tool's jointed parts, as :func:`read_parts` gives them.
    :raises ValueError: When the stage's part moves on no joint, on a joint
        of other units than its goal's, or over another travel, within the
        compiled scene's six significant digits.
    """
    if not isinstance(stage, Actuate):
        return
    if stage.part not in parts:
        raise ValueError(f"the tool moves no part {stage.part!r} on a joint")
    joint = joint_at(model, parts[stage.part])
    kind = KIND_NAMES[mujoco.mjtJoint(int(model.jnt_type[joint]))]
    if UNITS[kind] != stage.goal.units:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{stage.part} moves on a {kind}, in {UNITS[kind]}, but its goal is "
            f"in {stage.goal.units}"
        )
    if not model.jnt_limited[joint] or not np.allclose(
        model.jnt_range[joint], stage.goal.travel, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-9
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{stage.part} travels {model.jnt_range[joint].tolist()} {UNITS[kind]}, "
            f"not the goal's {stage.goal.travel}"
        )


def stands_as_scanned(axis_local: Array) -> bool:
    """Whether a tool whose base-to-tip axis runs along ``axis_local`` in
    its scan's frame stands as scanned, within :data:`STANDING_COSINE`."""
    return float(axis_local @ UP_AXIS_LOCAL) >= STANDING_COSINE


class ActuatedGrasp(PinchLift):
    """The pinch lift of an articulated tool, which counts every part's
    contacts toward the grip, reads the parts' joints for the task's
    :class:`~scripts.screwdriver_grasp_mpc.Actuate` stages, and reports them
    (:meth:`measurements`).

    A pinch centres between the tool's surfaces across its axis at the grip,
    found by rays, since a tool's root part, such as the drill's housing with
    its barrel and battery, reaches far wider than its handle. A tool that
    stands as scanned (:func:`stands_as_scanned`), the Windex bottle, is
    pinched about and gripped along its scan's up, as
    :class:`~scripts.upright_pinch_lift_mpc.UprightPinchLift` reads it; every
    other tool along its base-to-tip ports.

    :param stage: The stage of the task this objective serves.
    :param grips: Where the objective proposes to pinch the tool.
    :param parts: The tool's jointed parts, as :func:`read_parts` gives them.
    :raises ValueError: When ``stage`` is an actuation the tool cannot run
        (:func:`check_stage`).
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: mujoco.MjModel,
        data: mujoco.MjData,
        ids: SceneIds,
        stage: Stage,
        *,
        grips: tuple[Grip, ...] = (CENTRE_GRIP,),
        parts: Mapping[str, int],
    ) -> None:
        # The VoxPoser adapter builds this objective without the runner's
        # check of the whole task.
        check_stage(model, parts, stage)
        super().__init__(model, data, ids, stage, grips=grips)
        self.handle: set[int] = set(self.objects)
        if self.part_axis_local is not None and stands_as_scanned(self.axis_local):
            self.axis_local: Array = UP_AXIS_LOCAL
        #: Each jointed part's position address, by label.
        self.parts: dict[str, int] = dict(parts)
        kinds = {
            label: mujoco.mjtJoint(int(model.jnt_type[joint_at(model, address)]))
            for label, address in self.parts.items()
        }
        #: The derived quantities this tool reports.
        self.derived: list[Derived] = [
            quantity
            for quantity in DERIVED
            if all(kinds.get(label) == kind for label, kind in quantity.reads)
        ]
        #: Each part joint with stops: its low and high stop, in its units,
        #: and how far past them it may read (:data:`BEYOND_STOP`).
        self.stops: dict[str, tuple[float, float, float]] = {
            label: (*model.jnt_range[joint], BEYOND_STOP[kinds[label]])
            for label, address in self.parts.items()
            if model.jnt_limited[joint := joint_at(model, address)]
        }

    def accepts(self, data: mujoco.MjData, observation: PalmObservation) -> bool:
        """The stage's hold, refused while a part reads past a stop by more
        than :data:`BEYOND_STOP`: a part driven through its stop is broken,
        and a jammed trigger is no press."""
        return super().accepts(data, observation) and not any(
            excess > self.stops[label][2]
            for label, excess in self.beyond_stop(data).items()
        )

    def beyond_stop(self, data: mujoco.MjData) -> dict[str, float]:
        """How far each part joint with stops reads past them, in its units:
        zero within its travel."""
        return {
            label: max(
                0.0, low - self.joint(data, label), self.joint(data, label) - high
            )
            for label, (low, high, _) in self.stops.items()
        }

    def base_to_tip_local(self, data: mujoco.MjData) -> Array | None:
        """The port axis, or the scan's up for a tool that stands as scanned."""
        axis = super().base_to_tip_local(data)
        if axis is not None and stands_as_scanned(axis):
            return UP_AXIS_LOCAL
        return axis

    def joint(self, data: mujoco.MjData, label: str) -> float:
        return float(data.qpos[self.parts[label]])

    def lifting_pose(self, data: mujoco.MjData) -> tuple[Array, Array]:
        """Palm position and rotation that lift the tool: a tool resting on
        anything but the hand swings about its far end as the pinch lift's
        seed swings it; one the hand alone touches has no pivot, so the palm
        only rises, by at most :data:`LIFT_RISE_CAP_M`, toward the tool's
        lowest point reaching :data:`LIFT_CLEARANCE_M`. Swung about a point
        in the air, a tool held clear of the table turns in the pinch."""
        if self.resting(data):
            return super().lifting_pose(data)
        position = data.site_xpos[self.palm].copy()
        position[2] += float(
            np.clip(LIFT_CLEARANCE_M - self.whole_clearance(data), 0, LIFT_RISE_CAP_M)
        )
        return position, data.site_xmat[self.palm].reshape(3, 3).copy()

    def resting(self, data: mujoco.MjData) -> bool:
        """Whether anything but the hand touches the tool."""
        held = self.handle | self.ids.hand
        return any(
            {int(c.geom[0]), int(c.geom[1])} & self.handle
            and not {int(c.geom[0]), int(c.geom[1])} <= held
            for c in data.contact
        )

    def grip_site(self, data: mujoco.MjData, grip: Grip) -> tuple[Array, float, Array]:
        """The pinch at ``grip`` centred between the tool's surfaces across
        its axis there, with half their distance as its radius."""
        start, _, side = super().grip_site(data, grip)
        # Rays start beyond the tool's farthest collision vertex.
        points = mesh_points(self.model, data, self.objects)
        length = float(np.linalg.norm(points - start, axis=1).max()) + 0.01
        center, radius = surface_pinch(
            self.model, data, self.objects, start, side, length
        )
        return center, radius, side

    def measurements(self, data: mujoco.MjData) -> dict:
        """The pinch's loads, each part joint's position by label in
        ``part_joints``, the largest excess past a stop in ``beyond_stop``
        (in that joint's units), the derived quantities, read from positions
        clipped to their travel, and, under a hold with a pose goal, the
        cosine between the axis and the goal's vertical."""
        positions = {label: self.joint(data, label) for label in self.parts}
        clipped = positions | {
            label: float(np.clip(positions[label], low, high))
            for label, (low, high, _) in self.stops.items()
        }
        values = super().measurements(data) | {
            "part_joints": positions,
            "beyond_stop": max(self.beyond_stop(data).values(), default=0.0),
        }
        for quantity in self.derived:
            values[quantity.name] = quantity.formula(
                *(clipped[label] for label, _ in quantity.reads)
            )
        if self.hold.pose is not None:
            values["orientation_cosine"] = self.alignment(data, self.hold.pose)
        return values


def charged(task: Task, factor: float) -> Task:
    """``task`` with every actuation's charge scaled by ``factor``."""
    first, *rest = task
    return (
        first,
        *(
            replace(stage, charge=stage.charge * factor)
            if isinstance(stage, Actuate)
            else stage
            for stage in rest
        ),
    )


def actuate_arguments() -> tuple[argparse.Namespace, tuple[Grip, ...], Task]:
    """The runners' shared arguments, and the grips and task of the
    fixture's tool: ``--grips`` and ``--task`` when given, else its
    :data:`STOCK_GRIPS` and :data:`TASKS`, each actuation's charge scaled by
    ``--charge``. ``settings.json`` records the grips' and the task's JSON,
    before the scaling, whether they were given or not.
    """
    parser = argument_parser()
    parser.add_argument(
        "--grips",
        help="grips to propose, as JSON: [{site: {value, unit}}, ...] "
        "(default: the tool's stock grips)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--task", help="stages to run, as JSON (default: the tool's stock task)"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--charge",
        type=float,
        default=1.0,
        help="positive factor on every actuation's charge (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not (math.isfinite(args.charge) and args.charge > 0):
        parser.error(f"--charge: must be finite and positive, got {args.charge}")
    name = PartsRecord.read(args.input).object
    if name not in TASKS:
        parser.error(f"--input: {name} has no actuation task")
    try:
        # In 64-bit mode, so a goal keeps the precision it was written in.
        with jax.enable_x64():
            task = (
                TASKS[name]
                if args.task is None
                else ARTICULATED_TASK.validate_json(args.task)
            )
        grips = STOCK_GRIPS[name] if args.grips is None else parse_grips(args.grips)
    except ValueError as err:
        parser.error(str(err))
    args.task = ARTICULATED_TASK.dump_json(task).decode()
    args.grips = GRIPS.dump_json(grips).decode()
    return args, grips, charged(task, args.charge)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    args, grips, task = actuate_arguments()
    objective_source = Path(__file__).read_text()
    model = load_scene(args.input)
    parts = read_parts(args.input, model)
    for stage in task:
        check_stage(model, parts, stage)
    run(args, partial(ActuatedGrasp, grips=grips, parts=parts), task)
    (args.output / "objective.py").write_text(objective_source)
